rubric_items.reason: Repo filter, weekdaysByDoctor, service parsing, with_today partition and the page column/filter are tested; REQ-12 now has a test. S-6 AC2 (multi-page list, small filtered total on one page) still has no test.
Most assertions check exact ids, weekdays, totals, field errors and request URLs; the web REQ-11 test still only asserts the cell is not 'No availability'.
Invalid weekday values (0, 8, sat, 1.5, -1), empty weekday, no blocks, duplicate blocks, Sunday coding and the 21st-row page boundary are all covered.
Vitest+Supertest on the skippable PostgreSQL harness in api/test, jsdom+Testing Library in web/src/__tests__; every new test name starts with its ID and every traced REQ has a test.
No test counts or coverage numbers are stated; results are deferred to the verifier and coverage is noted as not measured.
